summary: Quote/Budget workflow feature testing - Iteration 34. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All quote workflow UI elements verified. The new feature for supplier quote submission and customer accept/reject with mandatory reason is fully functional.
seed_data_creation: Created test demands with quotes via API during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quote/Budget workflow feature fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: POST /api/demands/{id}/quotes (supplier submit), PUT /api/demands/{id}/quotes/{quote_id}/accept (customer accept), PUT /api/demands/{id}/quotes/{quote_id}/reject (customer reject with mandatory reason). Frontend: DemandDetail page shows 'Rozpočty a nabídky' section when status=in_progress. Supplier sees 'Nahrát rozpočet' button and upload form. Customer sees Accept/Reject buttons on pending quotes. Reject modal requires mandatory reason. Quote status badges: pending (yellow), accepted (green), rejected (red with reason). CraftBolt hexagonal helmet logo displays correctly.

BACKEND_QUOTE_SUBMIT.details: POST /api/demands/{id}/quotes - Supplier can submit quote with file_url, file_name, amount, note. Validates file extension, requires in_progress status, only assigned supplier can submit.

BACKEND_QUOTE_ACCEPT.details: PUT /api/demands/{id}/quotes/{quote_id}/accept - Customer can accept quote. Sets agreed_price from quote amount. Rejects other pending quotes automatically.

BACKEND_QUOTE_REJECT.details: PUT /api/demands/{id}/quotes/{quote_id}/reject - Customer can reject with mandatory reason. Returns 400 if reason is empty.

BACKEND_VALIDATION.details: Only assigned supplier can submit quotes, only customer can accept/reject, only in_progress demands allow quotes, file extension validation (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, jpg, jpeg, png allowed).

BACKEND_QUOTES_STRUCTURE.details: quotes array in demand response contains: id, supplier_id, supplier_name, file_url, file_name, amount, note, status, rejection_reason, created_at, responded_at

FRONTEND_QUOTES_SECTION.details: DemandDetail page shows 'Rozpočty a nabídky' section with data-testid='quotes-section' when status=in_progress for both customer and supplier

FRONTEND_SUPPLIER_UPLOAD.details: Supplier sees 'Nahrát rozpočet' button (data-testid='add-quote-btn'). Upload form shows file input, amount input, note input, submit button with correct data-testids.

FRONTEND_CUSTOMER_ACTIONS.details: Customer sees 'Přijmout nabídku' (accept) and 'Odmítnout' (reject) buttons on pending quotes

FRONTEND_REJECT_MODAL.details: Reject modal shows textarea for reason with 'Důvod odmítnutí *' label (mandatory). Submit button disabled until reason entered.

FRONTEND_QUOTE_BADGES.details: Quote status badges: 'Čeká na schválení' (yellow/pending), 'Přijato' (green/accepted), 'Odmítnuto' (red/rejected with reason displayed)

CRAFTBOLT_LOGO.details: New CraftBolt hexagonal helmet logo (data-testid='craftbolt-logo') displays correctly with SVG hexagon shape and 'Craft' (black) + 'Bolt' (orange) text

mocked_apis_list: BulkGate SMS (real credentials but may have 0 credit)
